snippet.title: Unwanted Host Gameplay - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Kill the parasite before it's too late… 💉

Unwanted Host is an indie horror strategy roguelite where you are trapped in a live torture show with a parasite inside your body. Use items to search for the parasite inside you and kill it. Buy new items to create powerful combinations and survive to escape the show.

Check Unwanted Host on Steam, and consider wishlisting it.
